description: This Python script is a command-line interface for initializing various software projects. It supports creating project configurations from CLI arguments, provides templates for different project types, and can output JSON summaries or retrieve specific run commands. It also includes detailed argument parsing and handles project-specific parameters.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class representing the initialization template information for a project.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for defining project parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class representing different project types with a method to parse from string.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating templates and initializing projects.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Constructs a minimal ProjectConfig for retrieving template info, mainly for get-run-command.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a base directory.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, ensuring paths are absolute.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a structured JSON response indicating success/failure, messages, and template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specified project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the process of retrieving and outputting the run command for a given project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function parsing CLI arguments, handling project initialization or get-run-command requests, and executing accordingly.
